title: Trend-to-Clip Factory
pitch: Chain last30days (which scans Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, and prediction markets to find what people are genuinely talking about on a topic right now) into autoclip (which turns raw video into ready-to-post captioned short clips). Each night the pipeline researches a creator's niche for the sharpest trending angle, drafts a short talking-points script, and runs it against the creator's own backlog of raw footage to produce two or three on-trend draft clips. A busy podcaster or YouTuber wakes up to clips they can approve and post immediately, instead of spending their Sunday night researching trends and then editing video to match them.
why_now: Short-form platforms reward same-day reaction content, but most creators lose the trend window doing manual research and then lose more time editing — chaining these two freshly-trending AI skills collapses both bottlenecks into a single overnight job.
